versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Cortex, persistent memory for AI agents.
- Features behavioral memory with 19 typed entries, including decay, reinforcement, and consolidation.
- Includes a document store (Vault) with CRUD operations and hybrid search; all changes are git-tracked.
- Automatic memory extraction from conversations via Observer.
- Supports hybrid search (BM25, semantic, temporal) using file-based, git-tracked storage.
